name: Reginleiv Orleans
original_name: レギンレイブ・オルレアン
source:
Due to the contract, she calls the [url=/c61578]Mutsuki[/url] "Master" and has absolute obedience to him, but sometimes she also defies him.

"My body is my Master's... but, this heart is for justice!"
